summary.text: David Smith is a Democratic member of the Missouri House of Representatives, District 46, who assumed office on January 4, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Smith is an attorney and co-founder of the law firm Smith & Parnell, LLC.

paragraphs.text: David T. Smith grew up in Columbia, Missouri, and graduated from Hickman High School in 1991.
He earned an undergraduate degree in sociology from the University of Missouri-Columbia in 1996 and a J.D. from Tulane Law School in 1999.
Smith's career experience includes working as an attorney and co-founding the law firm of Smith & Parnell, LLC.
He helped found Columbia's Citizens Police Review Board and was appointed to the Missouri Advisory Committee to the United States Commission on Civil Rights.
In the Missouri House, Smith was assigned to the House General Laws Committee, the Judiciary Committee and the Joint Committee on the Justice System for 2025-2026.
